results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Retrieve inbound SMS using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND (page through results until the returned data array is empty; optionally apply supported q/order_by filters).

[Optional (if inbound retrieval is unexpectedly empty)] [Prerequisite]: Check inbound polling setup using CLICKSEND_GET_AUTOMATIONS_SMS_INBOUND (confirm an enabled rule with action POLL exists for the target number).

[Optional (if no suitable polling rule exists)] [Prerequisite]: Create or enable polling using CLICKSEND_CREATE_AUTOMATIONS_SMS_INBOUND (set action POLL and the target number), then retry CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND.

[Fallback (if you need a strict window or full audit)] [Step]: Pull message history using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY (paginate until current_page==last_page, then keep only records where direction='in').
[Optional (after processing; confirm before write)] [Next Step]: Mark handled inbound messages as read using CLICKSEND_SMS_INBOUND_READ_PUT (reduces reprocessing on future unread pulls).
[Optional (if expected replies are missing)] [Next Step]: Verify outbound delivery using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_RECEIPTS (confirm the triggering outbound message was delivered).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND] Can return an empty data array even when inbound records exist in CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY (often tied to missing/disabled POLL automation).
[CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND] Typically returns unread inbound only; after CLICKSEND_SMS_INBOUND_READ_PUT those messages may no longer appear in subsequent unread fetches.
[CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND] Query filtering often expects field:value syntax; malformed q strings can silently yield zero matches.
[CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY] Payload is commonly nested under data.data.data while pagination metadata is under data.data; parsing the wrong level breaks filtering/paging.
[CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY] Inbound items may appear only on later pages; early pages can contain zero direction='in' even when later pages do.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickSend is a cloud-based SMS and email marketing platform that enables businesses to send and receive SMS messages, manage contacts, and track campaign performance.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clicksend. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clicksend") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clicksend tools.

CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND.description: Retrieves inbound SMS messages received by your ClickSend account. Use this tool when you need to: - View messages sent TO your ClickSend numbers FROM customers/recipients - Search for specific messages by sender, recipient, or content - Monitor incoming SMS replies and interactions Important: To receive inbound messages via API polling, you must first configure an inbound rule in the ClickSend Dashboard with the Action set to 'POLL'. By default, only unread messages are returned.

q.description: Search query to filter inbound SMS messages. Format: field_name:value (e.g., from:+61437085284). Searches are case-insensitive. Available searchable fields: from (sender number), to (recipient number), message_id, body (message text). Multiple criteria can be combined using the operator parameter Malformed queries silently return zero results instead of errors.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Default: 1 Increment iteratively with consistent limit to retrieve all records.

limit.description: Number of records per page. Default: 15

operator.description: Search operator to combine multiple search criteria in the q parameter. Use 'AND' to match all criteria (default) or 'OR' to match any criteria. Only relevant when multiple field:value pairs are provided in the q parameter

order_by.description: Sort order for results. Format: field_name:direction where direction is 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Default is 'date:asc' (oldest first). Use 'date:desc' to get newest messages first

CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY.description: Tool to retrieve sent SMS message history with filtering and pagination. Use when you need to view previously sent SMS messages or check delivery status.

q.description: Custom query string for filtering results. Format: field:value pairs separated by commas. Example: 'from:+61411111111,status_code:201' or 'status:Sent'. Searchable fields: status (Queued, Completed, Scheduled, WaitApproval, Failed, Cancelled, CancelledAfterReview, Received, Sent), to (recipient phone number). Searches are case-insensitive.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Used to navigate through result pages.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page.

date_to.description: Filter messages sent up to this date. Unix timestamp format (seconds since epoch).

operator.description: Logical operator for multiple search filters. Use 'AND' to match all filters or 'OR' to match any filter.

order_by.description: Sort results by field. Format: field:asc or field:desc (e.g., 'date:desc', 'status:asc').

date_from.description: Filter messages sent from this date onwards. Unix timestamp format (seconds since epoch).

CLICKSEND_GET_AUTOMATIONS_SMS_INBOUND.description: Tool to retrieve all inbound SMS automation rules configured in your ClickSend account. Use when you need to view or list all inbound SMS automation configurations. Supports pagination and filtering.

q.description: Search keyword or query filter to search automation rules

limit.description: Number of records per page. Default: 10
